english.title: Drop / deposit litter / waste at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[dropped]_
(B)_[deposited]_

**(..SPECIFY THE THING..) in such circumstances as to cause, contribute to, or tend to lead to, the defacement by litter pollution or waste substances of a part of Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(21) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
